sources.excerpt: The federal government's gross national debt has surpassed $34 trillion

reasoning: Official government reports from the U.S. House Committee on the Budget and reports from major news organizations confirm that the United States' gross national debt officially surpassed the $34 trillion mark on December 29, 2023. By early 2024, the figure had climbed even higher, exceeding $34.4 trillion by February 2024.
